kicker: THE WORLD'S NEWS IN ONE IMAGE
standfirst: Ten stories from one day, across business, war, law, climate, science and sport

stories.headline: Nvidia gives back ground a day after Huang's return
stories.detail: The board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday, after Trump pressed it. On Tuesday the stock gave back part of the surge that followed, leaving the decision a day old.

stories.headline: Ghalibaf rules out talks until seven conditions met
stories.detail: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf says Tehran will not negotiate until seven conditions are met, answering Monday's mining of three oil tankers.

stories.headline: Israeli strikes kill at least nine in Gaza
stories.detail: Four Israeli strikes on Tuesday killed at least nine people across Gaza. A senior Hamas security official was killed in Gaza City.

stories.headline: Zelensky confirms a Russian ship hit in the Gulf of Finland
stories.detail: Ukraine says it sank a Russian vessel in the Gulf of Finland; Norway urges caution as a Russian drone is found in Poland and NATO weighs surveillance aircraft.

stories.headline: EU sanctions package, a day old, widens its reach
stories.detail: The EU's 22nd package was unveiled on Monday; on Tuesday its new measures were detailed and the US Treasury widened its own sanctions.

stories.headline: Calls to reform how UN climate summits reach consensus
stories.detail: British and EU officials, meeting after the Antalya summit closed on Sunday, called for reform of UN climate talks. The UN said talks still produced technical agreements on geothermal, green freight corridors and clean electricity.

stories.headline: Malaysia to repatriate thousands more Myanmar migrants
stories.detail: Kuala Lumpur said on Tuesday it will repatriate thousands more Myanmar migrants, days after the ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

stories.headline: Chips fall as the rest of the market climbs
stories.detail: Nvidia fell more than 5%, erasing over half of Monday's gain, while much of the rest of the market rose on strong US consumer confidence. US markets had not closed.

stories.headline: Euclid finds the most distant quasar yet
stories.detail: A 360-million-sun-mass core seen just 630 million years after the Big Bang.

stories.headline: Hasina says she returns home on 16 December
stories.detail: After more than two years in exile. Humaiun Kobir, state minister for foreign affairs, says she can return only through extradition, in handcuffs or under strict surveillance.
